limitations: Observational association, not a causal intervention or effect of training.
Tags are multi-label; rows cannot be added as mutually exclusive categories.
Within-case differences compare tagged versus untagged conversations in the same case.
Mixed-only differences exclude uniform-outcome cases that have zero outcome variation.
Bootstrap resamples cases, not trajectories; intervals are exploratory and uncorrected for multiple comparisons.
Each tag has its own eligible case denominator. Sparse tags need manual evidence review.
Temporal direction is unresolved: assistant behavior can respond to earlier physician reasoning.

sparse_review.note: Only original positive candidates for these two tags were reviewed; false negatives were not exhaustively audited.

metadata.source_validation: All 120 questions/options matched public MedMCQA train parquet exactly.

publication_note: Case-adjusted associations did not show a stable positive relation: all calculable mixed-case bootstrap intervals include zero; contradiction flags have only one eligible mixed case. This is a descriptive audit of model annotations, not a causal validation of the reward.
